name: BlueGene/L alert logs
summary: Literal alert and non-alert messages from a real BlueGene/L supercomputer. The adapter preserves raw lines and source order; failure targets, time interpretation, templates and forecasting splits are not inferred.

availability.access: Public fixed archive; pdmdata CLI-helper transfer, provider MD5 and ZIP CRC verified

feature_dimensions.summary: Raw text, nine literal header fields and message content; no analogue sensor channels
feature_dimensions.counting: Source rows are not templates or confirmed failures. Clock precision, node field semantics and event-type construction require a separate audit.

attributes.name: raw_line
attributes.description: Original decoded UTF-8 line, including its line ending; retained even if the header cannot be parsed.

attributes.name: source_row
attributes.description: Zero-based source line index, preserved across streaming batch boundaries.

attributes.name: source_file
attributes.description: BGL.zip!BGL.log, BGL.log, or extracted/BGL.log, retaining the installed source path.

attributes.name: parse_ok
attributes.description: Whether the nine header fields and an optional message could be split. An empty message is retained as an empty string. Malformed rows remain present.

attributes.name: label / epoch / date / node / time / node_repeat / type / component / level / content
attributes.description: Literal source tokens, without timestamp, timezone, entity, anomaly or physical-failure coercion.

notes: The archive was fully downloaded using the pdmdata HTTP runtime, matched the provider MD5, and passed ZIP CRC verification. No performance result or forecasting-task adoption follows from this transfer.
The full archive is used for sequential audits; the 2,000-line parsing sample is not treated as a contiguous history.
Loading preserves source order, duplicates, malformed rows and original line endings. Invalid UTF-8 raises an error. Neither jitter nor template inference is performed.
The source use conditions require the Loghub URL, the relevant paper citation, and inclusion of its notice in copies. The license notice is stored in assets/SOURCE_LICENSE.
The native text and epoch clock relationship and the meaning of the two node fields are not assumed by the loader. An alert tag is not a verified physical failure.

A full-source audit found 34,470 complete nine-field headers with empty messages. These are parsed without dropping the row or its clock. The initial parser required a nonempty message; its source and audit were retained before this correction.
citation: Oliner, A. J., and Stearley, J. (2007). What Supercomputers Say: A Study of Five System Logs. DSN. Zhu, J., He, S., He, P., Liu, J., and Lyu, M. R. (2023). Loghub: A Large Collection of System Log Datasets for AI-driven Log Analytics. ISSRE.
